name: Nei Moh Han
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
A member of the Extra Thirteen in Posaydal's forces. A distinguished soldier, Nei piloted the A Class Heavy Metal Auge, which she used to make Daba's life miserable on more than one occasion. Tall and beautiful, she refused to abandon her feminine side, and wouldn't be caught dead without makeup.
